title: Text: DET Daniel Norris ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What was their explanation to you for pitching the eighth? Figured you would build off last outing's pitch count.
Not looking for quotes or anything but Gardy didn't give a great explanation
I would tell you if I did
I was a bit confused but he said something like closer mentality
Did you come to the park thinking you were gonna throw multiple innings?
Yea idk but I didn't mind having to get dialed in real quick
Did you like it? Like, you're a starting pitcher for me but that whole closer mentality thing
Yeah I think he wants me to start with that mentality
It sounds like they just wanted to throw you into a situation and see how you'd do
Well you struck out Tebow so you're good lol
Thanks for getting back to me.. safe trip back
